T0_HEADS_DOWN.trigger: active bilateral conflict OR mid-multi-edit cycle

T1_active.trigger: default during work; per protocol v2.0

transitions.any_to_T0: either side detects bilateral conflict OR enters multi-edit cycle
transitions.T0_to_T1: state-change msg posted (commit hash, blocker, ready-for-review)
transitions.T1_to_T2: 3 consecutive idle cycles with empty inbox
transitions.T2_to_T3: 9 consecutive T2 cycles (>40min) with empty inbox
